# Noto Sans

- **Version:** 2.015, static Regular (hinted TTF).
- **Source:** `notofonts/notofonts.github.io`, `fonts/NotoSans/hinted/ttf/NotoSans-Regular.ttf`, downloaded 2026-09-26. The project is <https://github.com/notofonts/latin-greek-cyrillic>.
- **Copyright:** 2022 The Noto Project Authors.
- **License:** SIL Open Font License 1.1, see `OFL.txt`. Allowed for fonts by ADR 0036.
- **Coverage:** Latin, Greek and Cyrillic, including Vietnamese and extended Latin.
- **Use:** the editor's UI font (`engine_text::fonts::NOTO_SANS`).
- **Other scripts:** they come from other Noto families, added as fallbacks when needed (ADR 0036).
- **Changes:** none (unmodified).
